body.title: Store: presenceOf read and markNotDeliveredIfHead
body.summary: In chat-queue-store.ts add presenceOf(windowKey) to ChatQueueLeases (a read returning the window's presence row, or undefined) and markNotDeliveredIfHead(seq) to ChatQueueStore: one IMMEDIATE transaction that re-reads the head with the existing LIVE_HEAD query (reused, not restated, so it cannot drift from head()) and, when the head's seq equals the given seq (state queued or retrying), sets state not-delivered with error 'its window was closed', clearing waiting_on; returns false otherwise. Both additive; no schema change.
acceptanceChecks: presenceOf returns pid, pidStartedAt and heartbeatAt for a window that wrote presence, and undefined for one that did not
markNotDeliveredIfHead marks the head and returns true; the next row becomes the head
a row acknowledged first by another connection is not marked and the call returns false
a retrying head is marked too

tests.name: chat-queue-store.test.ts: presenceOf returns the row, and undefined when there is none
chat-queue-store.test.ts: markNotDeliveredIfHead marks the head, the next row becomes the head, and a row acknowledged first by another connection is not marked
chat-queue-store.test.ts: markNotDeliveredIfHead marks a retrying head whose window closed and the next row becomes the head
